# Apache ECharts 6.1.0

Official npm package `echarts@6.1.0`, registry https://registry.npmjs.org/echarts/-/echarts-6.1.0.tgz . Vendored `dist/echarts.min.js` without modification for offline report charts. Apache-2.0; accompanying LICENSE and NOTICE retained. SHA256: `b66b25aeb4df84e33199dc21694014d336d222cbd9deb0e5a7c14bd6aa0d0fd0`.

Loaded on demand by the existing reports module, no runtime CDN or AI API. Resize/dispose follow https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/concepts/chart-size/ .
